context: Asuka and Riku tour a restored old building.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: architecture visit; structure vocabulary (建物/壁/区/入る/整備) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: この建物、きれいに整備されていますね。
lines.style: impressed teen boy voice, soft warm curious engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、この区が整備を続けています。
lines.en: Yes, this ward keeps it maintained.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 中に、入ってもいいですか?
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、静かに入りましょう。
lines.style: gentle teacher voice, soft warm guiding clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 壁が、しっかり整備されていますね。
lines.style: observant teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古い壁を、丁寧に直しています。
lines.en: They carefully repair the old walls.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: この区の人は、建物を大事にしますね。
lines.en: People in this ward cherish the building.
lines.style: reflective teen boy voice, soft warm warm understanding throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 整備のおかげで、今も中に入れます。
lines.en: Thanks to maintenance, we can still go inside.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity closing throughout
